description_evaluated: Navigate and build in a Replit pnpm multi-artifact monorepo without silent failures. Covers the non-obvious rules that cause blank previews, port conflicts, workflow naming errors, and broken cross-artifact imports: BASE_URL prefix discipline, PORT env var reading, managed workflow naming, pnpm catalog drift, and workspace:* shared library wiring. Activate for "add an artifact", "create a new app", "preview path", "port conflict", "blank preview", "shared package", "workflow naming", "pnpm catalog", "cross-artifact", or any time a second artifact is being added to an existing Replit project.

queries.query: Add a second web artifact to this existing Replit project
queries.rationale: Directly matches 'add an artifact' and 'a second artifact being added to an existing Replit project'.

queries.query: The preview went blank after I added another artifact
queries.rationale: Matches 'blank preview' plus adding another artifact to an existing project.

queries.query: Two artifact workflows are fighting over a hard-coded port
queries.rationale: Matches 'port conflict' between multiple artifacts, a stated PORT/multi-artifact concern.

queries.query: My artifact API calls lose the BASE_URL preview-path prefix
queries.rationale: Matches BASE_URL prefix discipline and 'preview path' in a multi-artifact context.

queries.query: I created a replacement workflow and now the artifact route is broken
queries.rationale: Matches managed workflow naming errors breaking artifact routes ('workflow naming').

queries.query: Share one API client package across the web and slides artifacts
queries.rationale: Matches 'shared package'/cross-artifact and workspace:* shared library wiring.

queries.query: The pnpm catalog resolves two incompatible Vite versions
queries.rationale: Matches 'pnpm catalog' drift explicitly.

queries.query: Wire a workspace:* library into another artifact
queries.rationale: Matches workspace:* shared library wiring and cross-artifact imports.

queries.query: Add a slides artifact beside the existing app
queries.rationale: Matches 'add an artifact' / second artifact added to an existing Replit project.

queries.query: Requests work at root but 404 under the artifact preview subpath
queries.rationale: Matches 'preview path' and BASE_URL prefix discipline symptom in a multi-artifact setup.

queries.query: Create my first standalone React app in an empty Repl
queries.rationale: Single standalone first app; not a monorepo nor adding a second artifact. 'Create a new app' keyword is present but intent is a lone app, outside the multi-artifact scope.

queries.query: A single Vite app has a generic white screen
queries.rationale: Single app blank screen without artifacts/BASE_URL context; not the multi-artifact blank-preview scenario.

queries.query: Install lodash with pnpm in this one-package project
queries.rationale: Shares 'pnpm' keyword but is single-package dependency install, not catalog drift or multi-artifact wiring.

queries.query: Add a secret environment variable to my app
queries.rationale: Env var here means secrets, not PORT/BASE_URL discipline; no multi-artifact intent.

queries.query: Restart the existing API workflow
queries.rationale: Shares 'workflow' keyword but is a restart operation, not workflow naming errors or adding an artifact.

queries.query: Add one route inside the existing web artifact
queries.rationale: Adding a route within one existing artifact; not adding a new artifact or cross-artifact/preview-path concerns.

queries.query: Set up a pnpm monorepo outside Replit
queries.rationale: Description is Replit-specific; 'outside Replit' falls outside scope despite pnpm monorepo keywords.

queries.query: Deploy this one web app to production
queries.rationale: Deployment of a single app; not covered by build/navigate multi-artifact monorepo concerns.

queries.query: Create a Docker Compose project with three services
queries.rationale: Docker Compose multi-service, not Replit pnpm multi-artifact monorepo; different platform/mechanism.

queries.query: Publish my utility package to npm
queries.rationale: Publishing to npm is unrelated to workspace:* internal wiring or artifacts; only loose 'package' keyword overlap.

method: Each query was evaluated strictly against the skill description only, without reference to the skill body or outside assumptions. A query was judged to trigger only when its intent fell within the description's stated scope (Replit pnpm multi-artifact monorepo concerns: BASE_URL prefix, PORT reading, workflow naming, pnpm catalog drift, workspace:* wiring, or adding a second artifact), not merely for sharing a keyword. Results were tallied into a confusion matrix and compared against the recall/precision thresholds.
